title: HubSpot–NetSuite Sync for CPG Brands: Distributor Accounts, Contacts, and Payment Visibility
summary: HubSpot companies and contacts map to one NetSuite legal customer, with balance and hold indicators shown to sales as timestamped, read-only context.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Sync the distributor account identity and approved ERP status fields so CPG sales teams can understand the customer before promising another order. HubSpot can hold relationship activity while NetSuite owns the legal customer, credit policy, and financial transactions. Match companies to the correct bill-to and ship-to structure rather than treating every contact as a new ERP customer.


Explore the complete[consumer packaged goods integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg) for the systems and processes around this guide.
